pages.text: A greatsword from legend, capable of turning obstructing riff-raff into ghosts wandering the starless dark night.

pages.title: Starless Night
pages.text: Each attack records the number of hits and accumulates a damage multiplier based on that count (by default, up to 4 times), dealing [Base Damage * (Hit Count * Damage Multiplier + 1)] points of damage.$(br)If damage caused by Starless Night results in the death of the attacked creature, and the final blow's damage exceeds the creature's health before death, the excess damage will chain to the nearest creature surrounding the attacked creature.
